**BUA Psykiatrisk Klinik for Udredning** is a child and adolescent psychiatric assessment clinic operating in the Central Denmark Region (Midtjylland). It functions as a specialized unit within [[aarhus-universitetshospital-psykiatrien|Aarhus Universitetshospital, Psykiatrien]] [^src3] and contributes its clinical data to the national [[adhd-databasen|ADHD-DATABASEN]] for quality monitoring [^src2]. 

The clinic is primarily significant in national healthcare reports for highlighting severe regional inequalities and systemic weaknesses in the implementation of standardized diagnostic procedures. According to the 2023 national quality monitoring data, BUA Psykiatrisk Klinik for Udredning recorded the lowest compliance rate for Indicator 2b (manualized diagnostics) in the country, fulfilling the standard in only 22% of its 433 assessment courses [^src1]. This extremely critical performance level stands in stark contrast to national standards and top-performing reference departments, such as the outpatient clinic in Odense [^src1]. 

In more recent technical and organizational evaluations covering the period from April 1, 2024, to March 31, 2025, the clinic's data collection practices were analyzed alongside regional variations in using course markers to validate statistics [^src3]. During this 2024–2025 period, the clinic registered 12 disproved (*afkræftede*) assessment courses [^src3]. These figures are part of a broader national effort to ensure data validation and monitor the balance between non-pharmacological and pharmacological treatments in the Danish ADHD intervention system [^src2].
